title: Testing Multi-Factor Authentication
description: MFA assessment questionnaire. Verdict: Not Compromised if >=2 factors are confirmed present and tested. Compromised if MFA is absent or only one factor is present.

factor_catalog.name: TOTP / Authenticator App
factor_catalog.example: Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator — time-based one-time password

factor_catalog.name: Push Notification Approval
factor_catalog.example: Duo Push, Okta Verify — approve/deny via mobile app

factor_catalog.name: SMS OTP
factor_catalog.example: One-time code sent by text message (NIST RESTRICTED — SIM-swap risk)

factor_catalog.name: Email OTP
factor_catalog.example: One-time code or magic link sent to registered email address

factor_catalog.name: Biometric
factor_catalog.example: Fingerprint, Face ID, iris scan — typically device-local

factor_catalog.name: Voice Call OTP
factor_catalog.example: Automated phone call reads a one-time code

factor_catalog.name: Backup / Recovery Codes
factor_catalog.example: Pre-generated single-use recovery codes — not a standalone second factor

factor_catalog.name: Password / PIN
factor_catalog.example: Standard memorised secret — always present as factor 1
